tools.name: heartlandretail_whoami
tools.description: Show the Heartland Retail user behind the API token, and confirm the token works. Use it first when a call returns 401 or 403. Heartland Retail: GET /api/system/whoami.

tools.name: heartlandretail_list_items
tools.description: Search the store's items (products) by text or JSON filter, with cost, price and vendor ids. Heartland Retail: GET /api/items.

tools.name: heartlandretail_get_item
tools.description: Get one item by id: cost, price, financial class and primary vendor. Heartland Retail: GET /api/items/{item_id}.

tools.name: heartlandretail_list_inventory_values
tools.description: Show stock quantities and values, optionally grouped (for example by item_id or location_id) and filtered to one item. Heartland Retail: GET /api/inventory/values.

tools.name: heartlandretail_list_locations
tools.description: List the store's locations (stores, warehouses) with their ids. Heartland Retail: GET /api/locations.

tools.name: heartlandretail_list_customers
tools.description: Search customers by name, email or a JSON filter. Heartland Retail: GET /api/customers.

tools.name: heartlandretail_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id: name, email, default address ids, custom fields and loyalty points. Heartland Retail: GET /api/customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: heartlandretail_create_customer
tools.description: Create a customer. Give a first name or a last name (or both). Returns the new customer id. Heartland Retail: POST /api/customers.

tools.name: heartlandretail_update_customer
tools.description: Change the name or email of one customer. Only the fields you give change. Heartland Retail: PUT /api/customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: heartlandretail_list_sales_orders
tools.description: Search sales orders by text or JSON filter (for example a status). Shows customer, status, shipping and totals. Heartland Retail: GET /api/sales/orders.

tools.name: heartlandretail_get_sales_order
tools.description: Get one sales order by id. Heartland Retail: GET /api/sales/orders/{order_id}.

tools.name: heartlandretail_list_sales_order_lines
tools.description: List the lines (items, quantities, prices) of one sales order. Heartland Retail: GET /api/sales/orders/{order_id}/lines.

tools.name: heartlandretail_list_sales_invoices
tools.description: Search sales invoices by text or JSON filter. Heartland Retail: GET /api/sales/invoices.

tools.name: heartlandretail_list_sales_tickets
tools.description: Search point-of-sale tickets (till sales) by text or JSON filter. Heartland Retail: GET /api/sales/tickets.

tools.name: heartlandretail_list_vendors
tools.description: Search purchasing vendors (suppliers) by text or JSON filter. Heartland Retail: GET /api/purchasing/vendors.

tools.name: heartlandretail_get_gift_card
tools.description: Get one gift card by its card number: value and status. Heartland Retail: GET /api/gift_cards/{gift_card_number}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: heartlandretail_list_customers, heartlandretail_get_customer, heartlandretail_list_sales_tickets · Private data: heartlandretail_whoami · Public sink: heartlandretail_list_customers, heartlandretail_get_customer, heartlandretail_create_customer, heartlandretail_update_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: heartlandretail_list_customers, heartlandretail_get_customer, heartlandretail_list_sales_tickets · Private data: heartlandretail_whoami · Public sink: heartlandretail_list_customers, heartlandretail_get_customer, heartlandretail_create_customer, heartlandretail_update_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
